record.field: The Consultant shall perform the services described in the Scope of Services and Deliverables sections of this Letter of Appointment.
Invoices are payable within the number of days stated in the Payment Terms. Payment is conditional on the milestone evidence stated for each stage.
The Consultant's liability is limited to the cap stated in the Particulars and the Consultant shall maintain the insurance stated therein.
Either party may terminate on the notice period stated in the Particulars, subject to the cure period for remediable breaches.
This appointment is governed by the law and forum stated in the Particulars.
